description: DCA demo execution (ADR 0004, defaults per ADR 0006): execution enabled by default so bounded additions (InpMaxDcaAdds) run on demo immediately. Per-add volume cap, basket loss budget and a mandatory basket SL/TP. No unbounded martingale. Demo account or Strategy Tester only; real accounts rejected at OnInit. Set InpEnableExecution=false for a dry-run comparison.

assumptions.account: demo or Strategy Tester only; real/contest accounts are rejected at OnInit
assumptions.position_model: one basket of up to InpMaxDcaAdds+1 broker positions filtered by symbol and InpMagicNumber; one direction only
assumptions.volume: add n volume = InpBaseVolume * InpAddVolumeMultiplier^n, floored to the broker volume step and capped by InpMaxAddVolume and InpMaxExposure
assumptions.adds: at most one addition per bar; InpMaxDcaAdds=0 disables additions entirely
assumptions.stops: basket SL/TP are absolute prices derived from the live average entry; every leg carries them and they are re-asserted after each add
assumptions.risk_budget: at any time the loss of the whole basket at its stop must stay under InpMaxBasketLossPct of equity, otherwise the add is rejected
assumptions.locks: daily loss and drawdown halts flatten the basket and stop new entries; InpMaxConsecutiveLosses blocks the next basket
assumptions.kill_switch: create InpKillSwitchFile in MQL5/Files to close the basket and stop entries until restart
assumptions.results: demo execution is an operational check, not a performance or live-readiness claim
